CustomField.description: Not a setting: when the Rollup Queue last asked for a processor (or, for one queued with a delay, when it is due to start). A save that queues totals reads it instead of querying for a waiting processor, and asks the subscriber to check exactly while it is recent (D-200 P13). Written by the engine only; not shown in the settings console.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Used by BarnCRM to know when the Rollup Queue last asked for a processor.
CustomField.label: Processor Requested At
